mapper.select: select id, quote_no, currency_pair, bid_rate, ask_rate, locked_rate, status, expire_time, remittance_no, create_time, update_time from cross_border_fx_quote where quote_no = #{quoteNo}
mapper.insert: insert into cross_border_fx_quote (quote_no, currency_pair, bid_rate, ask_rate, locked_rate, status, expire_time, remittance_no) values (#{quoteNo}, #{currencyPair}, #{bidRate}, #{askRate}, #{lockedRate}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{remittanceNo})
mapper.update: update cross_border_fx_quote set status = 2, remittance_no = #{remittanceNo}, locked_rate = #{lockedRate} where quote_no = #{quoteNo} and status = 1 and expire_time > now()
update cross_border_fx_quote set status = 4 where status = 1 and expire_time <= #{now}
